voice.name: en-GB-SoniaNeural
voice.prosody: The portal opened, and the family tumbled back into their kitchen, right where they'd started. The Nintendo was fixed. Breakfast was still warm. And best of all — Lili and Leo weren't fighting anymore.

voice.name: en-GB-SoniaNeural
voice.prosody: said Lili, smiling at all of them.

voice.name: en-GB-RyanNeural
voice.prosody: "Want to play a game together later? A real one?"

voice.name: en-GB-SoniaNeural
voice.prosody: And they all sat down and ate breakfast together — the happiest family in any world, real or video game. The End.
